tools.name: list_municipalities
tools.description: List the 78 accepted Puerto Rico municipality names for the city filter. Preserves official accents.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Read one public business or event by the kind and id returned from discover_listings. Returns its canonical link; archived or quarantined entries are unavailable.

tools.name: discover_listings
tools.description: Find matching Puerto Rico businesses and current or upcoming events. Disclosed paid placements may appear first; placement is not an independent recommendation.

tools.name: highlighted_services
tools.description: List currently highlighted services, explicitly labelled as paid sponsorship or the publisher's own service. Includes canonical links and no payment action.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List valid Puerto Rico directory category IDs for discover_listings.
